elements.name: Changeling
elements.desc: Changelings can shift their forms with a thought. Many changelings use this gift as a form of artistic and emotional expression.

elements.name: Shapechanger
elements.desc: As an action, you can change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes, including your coloration, hair length, and sex.

elements.name: Kalashtar
elements.desc: The kalashtar are a compound people, created from the union of humanity and renegade spirits from the plane of dreams—spirits called quori.

elements.name: Dual Mind
elements.desc: You have advantage on all Wisdom saving throws.

elements.name: Mental Discipline
elements.desc: You have resistance to psychic damage.

elements.name: Mind Link
elements.desc: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see, provided the creature is within a number of feet of you equal to 10 times your level.

elements.name: Severed from Dreams
elements.desc: You are immune to spells and other magical effects that require you to dream, like dream.

elements.name: Orc
elements.desc: Thousands of years before humans came to Khorvaire, the land was dominated by wild orcs and goblinoids of the Dhakaani Empire.

elements.name: Aggressive
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear.

elements.name: Powerful Build
elements.desc: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

elements.name: Shifter
elements.desc: Shifters are sometimes called the weretouched, as many believe they are the descendants of humans and lycanthropes.

elements.name: Shifting
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can assume a more bestial appearance. When you shift, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier.

elements.name: Beasthide
elements.desc: Stoic and solid, a beasthide shifter draws strength and stability from the beast within.

elements.name: Beasthide Shifting
elements.desc: Whenever you shift, you gain 1d6 additional temporary hit points. While shifted, you have a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

elements.name: Longtooth
elements.desc: Longtooth shifters are fierce and aggressive, but they form deep bonds with their friends.

elements.name: Longtooth Shifting
elements.desc: While shifted, you can use your elongated fangs to make an unarmed strike as a bonus action dealing 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage.

elements.name: Swiftstride
elements.desc: Swiftstride shifters are graceful and quick. Typically feline in nature.

elements.name: Swiftstride Shifting
elements.desc: While shifted, your walking speed increases by 10 feet. Additionally, you can move up to 10 feet as a reaction when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of you.

elements.name: Wildhunt
elements.desc: Wildhunt shifters are sharp and insightful. Many are constantly alert.

elements.name: Wildhunt Shifting
elements.desc: While shifted, you have advantage on Wisdom checks, and no creature within 30 feet of you can make an attack roll with advantage against you.

elements.name: Warforged
elements.desc: The warforged were built to fight in the Last War.

elements.name: Constructed Resilience
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and you have resistance to poison damage. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe. You are immune to disease. You don't need to sleep.

elements.name: Sentry's Rest
elements.desc: When you take a long rest, you must spend at least six hours in an inactive, motionless state, rather than sleeping.

elements.name: Integrated Protection
elements.desc: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class. You can don only armor with which you have proficiency.

elements.name: Ability Score Increase (Strength)
elements.desc: Your Strength score increases by 1.

elements.name: Ability Score Increase (Dexterity)
elements.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

elements.name: Ability Score Increase (Constitution)
elements.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 1.

elements.name: Ability Score Increase (Intelligence)
elements.desc: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

elements.name: Ability Score Increase (Wisdom)
elements.desc: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

elements.name: Ability Score Increase (Charisma)
elements.desc: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

elements.name: Mark of Detection
elements.desc: If your half-elf character has the Mark of Detection, the following traits replace the half-elf's Ability Score Increase and Skill Versatility traits. Replaces: Half-Elf ASI (+2 Cha, +1×2) and Skill Versatility.

elements.name: Deductive Intuition
elements.desc: When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Magical Detection
elements.desc: You can cast the detect magic and detect poison and disease spells with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast the see invisibility spell with it.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Detection)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Detection Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Finding
elements.desc: If your half-orc character has the Mark of Finding, the following traits replace the character's racial traits. Replaces: all Half-Orc traits.

elements.name: Mark of Finding
elements.desc: If your human character has the Mark of Finding, the following traits replace the character's racial traits. Replaces: all Human traits.

elements.name: Hunter's Intuition
elements.desc: When you make a Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Finder's Magic
elements.desc: You can cast the hunter's mark spell with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast the locate object spell with it.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Finding)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Finding Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Handling
elements.desc: If your human character has the Mark of Handling, the following traits replace the human's Ability Score Increase trait. Replaces: Human ASI (+1×6).

elements.name: Wild Intuition
elements.desc: When you make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) or Intelligence (Nature) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Primal Connection
elements.desc: You can cast the animal friendship and speak with animals spells with this trait.

elements.name: The Bigger They Are
elements.desc: Starting at 3rd level, you can target a beast or monstrosity when you cast animal friendship or speak with animals.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Handling)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Handling Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Healing
elements.desc: If you're a halfling with the Mark of Healing, you have this subrace.

elements.name: Medical Intuition
elements.desc: When you make a Wisdom (Medicine) check or an ability check using an herbalism kit, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Healing Touch
elements.desc: You can cast the cure wounds spell with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast lesser restoration with it.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Healing)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Healing Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Hospitality
elements.desc: If you're a halfling with the Mark of Hospitality, you have this subrace.

elements.name: Ever Hospitable
elements.desc: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check or an ability check involving brewer's supplies or cook's utensils, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Innkeeper's Magic
elements.desc: You know the prestidigitation cantrip. You can also cast the purify food and drink and unseen servant spells with this trait.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Hospitality)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Hospitality Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Making
elements.desc: If your human character has the Mark of Making, the following traits replace the human's Ability Score Increase trait. Replaces: Human ASI (+1×6).

elements.name: Artisan's Intuition
elements.desc: When you make an Arcana check or an ability check involving artisan's tools, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Spellsmith
elements.desc: You know the mending cantrip. You can also cast the magic weapon spell with this trait.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Making)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Making Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Passage
elements.desc: If your human character has the Mark of Passage, the following traits replace the human's Ability Score Increase trait. Replaces: Human ASI (+1×6).

elements.name: Courier's Speed
elements.desc: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

elements.name: Intuitive Motion
elements.desc: When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or any ability check to operate or maintain a land vehicle, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Magical Passage
elements.desc: You can cast the misty step spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it when you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Passage)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Passage Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Scribing
elements.desc: If you're a gnome with the Mark of Scribing, you have this subrace.

elements.name: Gifted Scribe
elements.desc: When you make an Intelligence (History) check or an ability check using calligrapher's supplies, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Scribe's Insight
elements.desc: You know the message cantrip. You can also cast comprehend languages once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it when you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Scribing)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Scribing Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Sentinel
elements.desc: If your human character has the Mark of Sentinel, the following traits replace the human's Ability Score Increase trait. Replaces: Human ASI (+1×6).

elements.name: Sentinel's Intuition
elements.desc: When you make a Wisdom (Insight) or Wisdom (Perception) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Guardian's Shield
elements.desc: You can cast the shield spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it after you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Vigilant Guardian
elements.desc: When a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to swap places with that creature, and you are hit by the attack instead.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Sentinel)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Sentinel Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Shadow
elements.desc: If you're an elf with the Mark of Shadow, you have this subrace.

elements.name: Cunning Intuition
elements.desc: When you make a Charisma (Performance) or Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Shape Shadows
elements.desc: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the invisibility spell once with this trait.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Shadow)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Shadow Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Storm
elements.desc: If your half-elf character has the Mark of Storm, the following traits replace the half-elf's Ability Score Increase and Skill Versatility traits. Replaces: Half-Elf ASI (+2 Cha, +1×2) and Skill Versatility.

elements.name: Windwright's Intuition
elements.desc: When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or any ability check involving navigator's tools, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Storm's Boon
elements.desc: You have resistance to lightning damage.

elements.name: Headwinds
elements.desc: You know the gust cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the gust of wind spell once with this trait.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Storm)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Storm Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

elements.name: Mark of Warding
elements.desc: If you're a dwarf with the Mark of Warding, you have this subrace.

elements.name: Warder's Intuition
elements.desc: When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) check or an ability check using thieves' tools, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

elements.name: Wards and Seals
elements.desc: You can cast the alarm and mage armor spells with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast the arcane lock spell with it.

elements.name: Spells of the Mark (Warding)
elements.desc: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Warding Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.
